checks.title: Valid citations dropped when Gemini writes chunk ids in square brackets: every judgment shows 'Unsupported / Not covered by the sources'
checks.inputs: F10b form (LLM training quiz, who checks 'QA receives it'), Gemini; and its round 2 (F10d)
checks.expected: Citations to map paragraphs are kept and shown as sources
checks.observed: In both results (8253096661bb, 18516db9a909) Gemini returned citations as "[A22:1:1]" and "[A22:3.3:0]" (raw_output in the audit record, proposed_ids in the saved result). The citation check compares the raw string with the allowed ids, so all were dropped: GMP relevance, Model type and Autonomy each show the badge 'Unsupported' and 'Not covered by the sources', plus the warning 'No supporting passage found for: gmp_relevance, model_type, autonomy'. Without the brackets these ids are in the retrieved set and in the source map for those answers (source_map.describe returns an entry for non_critical/generative/recommends + A22:1:1 and recommends + A22:3.3:0). The other Gemini results cite the same ids without brackets and show sources. Likely cause: the prompt tags passages and the map list as "[<chunk id>]" (app/llm/prompts.py lines 82 and 102) and app/citations.py check_judgment does not strip brackets.
checks.why_flagged: Clear wrong behaviour: correct, map-approved citations are hidden and the page tells the proposer the judgments are not backed by any source. Outcome unaffected (rules do not depend on citations).
